notes: Round-2 revision, SUPERSEDING the prior file wholesale (that file answered ux-2026-07-28-kpos-redesign; this one answers ui-integration-2026-07-29, the integration pass). Grounding: ui-demos/kpos-shell/README.md plus direct reads of kp.css, system.css, windows.css, wm.ts, w-embed.ts, ui.ts, w-shopfront.ts, w-darknet.ts, inbox.html, card.html, dive-report.html, dive.html, dive.ts; live-state grounding from kernel-panic-site/app/src (shop-os.tsx, screens.tsx, duel.tsx, teach.tsx, content/teaching.ts, game/audio.ts, game/save.ts, content/customers.ts, content/journal.ts, content/arc.ts, components/os/wm.tsx, components/os/wm.css). The demo look is settled law; every item below states an INTEGRATION BINDING (what live data/dispatch/reducer field a demo surface reads from) rather than re-deriving visuals the demo already settled. Engine hooks this file asks the Orchestrator to budget, named plainly per item: WindowManager gains resize(id,w) (kpos-inbox-window); DuelFinish and RunState.lastResult gain a capped log:string[] field (kpos-repairlog-window, fed by a new BUS.LOG transcript inside duel.tsx itself, kpos-dive-exe); shop-os.tsx's isFinaleDive boolean gains one more true case for finalePre (kpos-backroom-lck); WIN_DEFS grows from 6 to 9 entries and windowTitle() drops its day/analyze/result branches (kpos-v2-tokens-system). None of these are balance/mechanics changes: no win-rate, cost, or curve number is read or written by any of them. Two dependencies on other agents' gates, both stated inline rather than blocking: the SIG-0 to INTRUSION board-tag rename (kpos-dive-exe) waits on the loremaster clearing the narrative-director's rename item; INBOX's per-job subject lines (kpos-inbox-window) wait on the narrative-director's copy pass, with an explicit non-blank fallback until then. One deliberate non-decision: DARKNET.LNK's 'SELLER: SIGNAL SCRAMBLED, NO ID ON FILE' copy is better served by having no vendor portrait at all (a clear face would contradict 'no ID on file'); no art order is filed for a vendor cell, and the window's existing round-1 spec (heavier dither field, notched bar) already carries the 'odd one out' read without one. Also deliberately not reordered: the four existing story stills (still-bench/-counter/-locked/-open). I visually inspected still-locked.png: it already carries strong luminance-based separation (a warm lit focal point against desaturated blue-grey machinery) that grayscale+multiply reads cleanly; by extension the other three from the same pass are judged fine. No re-treatment order filed this cycle; a specific still reading muddy after the live tint lands is a small follow-up, not a blocker now. Art orders filed (9 files, pipeline/art/orders/): CUSTOMER.REC card imagery (portrait + device macro, 304x304 - the house dither-cell size already established twice in banked work, adopted here for consistency) for the three customers current studies already placeholder-borrow Dex Marlowe's dithers for (Juno Vex, Sable Okonkwo, Aldous Wick) - this is the highest-value gap since it closes an active wrong-face bug on two live windows at once; plus two more REPAIR.LOG happy-client figures (162x234, the cell's established exact size) for the next-most-frequently-seen customers, Wren Tallis and Bram Hollander; plus one reuse-only order registering the already-banked solder-bench-fine.png into MANUAL.TXT's PATCHES tab (zero new generation). Full 12-customer roster coverage is a multi-cycle effort and every customer-likeness order explicitly notes it waits on the loremaster's appearance-canon ruling regardless of budget. Estimated spend at 1-2 attempts per image: 16 to 32 credits of the 60-credit cap, leaving slack for retries on the harder prompts (the REPAIR.LOG figure pass needed two retakes last cycle to purge baked-in lettering, per the README). Sound: the full port list of sound.ts's seven demo-only presets into audio.ts, all still open (never yet integrated): the five SOLDER.BAY presets (gate-cleared in the craft-station cycle, carried forward verbatim) plus pageFlip and winFocus. Two more sound gaps closed as BINDINGS inside the relevant ui-spec text rather than new presets, since inbox.html and dive-report.html ship with zero sound calls at all today: INBOX's ticket open/close reuses the existing icon/tick presets; REPAIR.LOG's draft pick and footer navigation reuse the existing granted/press presets exactly as today's ResultScreen already does. Tutorial-agent flags to note in gate review: kpos-inbox-window states explicitly where the analyze-readout moment's MODE_TELL tell line must be re-added (the card study drops it; the mechanic's only coverage depends on it surviving); kpos-teach-callout-v2 re-anchors all eight existing anchor classes against the new window layouts and restates the telegraph-safety rule in board-wrapper-relative terms since DIVE.EXE no longer fills the raw viewport the old kp-dive2 did.

items.spec: Native port of inbox.html + card.html's CUSTOMER.REC anatomy as the 'inbox' WinDef, replacing JobBoard AND AnalyzeScreen: run.screen 'day' and 'analyze' both render through this ONE window's body (the reducer's screen strings are unchanged, only their presentation merges). Row click dispatches the existing {type:'pickJob', index:i} then the window steps open per inbox.html's own choreography (see RESIZE MECHANISM below). Clicking the open row again collapses the window WITHOUT dispatching backToDay - filing a ticket away is a pure presentation collapse, run.screen stays 'day' the whole time a ticket is merely being reviewed; only the explicit BACK button dispatches backToDay. EXPANDED CARD (run.screen==='analyze'): card.html's anatomy, with the LEFT photo cell bound to c.portrait (existing shipped path, shown pixelated at the 304x304 house cell size, not a new asset) and the RIGHT cell bound to this cycle's new device-macro art order path where one exists (see art orders); a customer with no macro order yet falls back to c.portrait a second time rather than an empty cell. The two bracket-only decorative cells (fingerprint dot-block, eye crop) are pure decoration per the study's own construction, ported verbatim, seeded off job.customerId (never Math.random, so re-renders never redraw them). CARD-ROWS is the FULL existing AnalyzeScreen READOUT field set (screens.tsx:296-329): NAME, DEVICE, DOMINANT ROUTINE, THREAT TIER (diamond row, job.tier of 5), GRID (day.grid), INTRUSION RAM (day.oppRam/turn), WARNING (day.headStart>0 only, kp-datarow-warn) - NOT the card study's own smaller NAME/DEVICE/ROUTINE/TIER/RATE/BOOT/DROPS set, whose TICKET RATE/LAST CLEAN BOOT/POUCH DROPS rows are demo flavor with no reducer backing and are dropped, while GRID/INTRUSION RAM/WARNING (which the study never had) are REQUIRED additions or the diagnostic loses live threat data it carries today. ACTIONS row (new; the read-only study has none): BACK (kp-btn2-ghost, dispatches backToDay then collapses), CONFIGURE KIT (kp-btn2-ghost, opens LOADOUT.CFG, no screen change), DIVE (kp-btn2-signal, dispatches the existing {type:'startDuel'}). EMPTY STATE: run.jobsDone.every(Boolean) collapses the list to one dim non-interactive 'ALL TICKETS FILED' row instead of three now-meaningless done rows. RESIZE MECHANISM (the one new window-management primitive this file needs): WindowManager (wm.tsx) gains resize(id,w) mirroring the existing move(id,x,y) exactly (a widths record, a resizeOf(id) reader defaulting to def.w); FloatingWindow reads this instead of def.w directly for its rendered width. items.when: Carried forward from the gate-cleared craft-station cycle, still not integrated into audio.ts. A SOLDER.BAY rack piece is picked up: on live drag commit past the 6px threshold, or on the first tap/keyboard activation that selects a piece. Fires once per pickup. A light, tactile metal-part click, more substantial than the chrome-level tick/press presets since this is a game object leaving its slot.

Carried forward from the gate-cleared craft-station cycle. A held SOLDER.BAY piece newly enters a rack slot that would form a legal union, during a live drag. Fires once per entry, not on re-entry of the same slot without leaving; light and short since a single drag may cross several legal slots in a row.

Carried forward from the gate-cleared craft-station cycle. A held SOLDER.BAY piece newly enters a rack slot that would NOT form a legal union (empty, its own origin, or a subset/equal union). Fires once per entry. Duller and quieter than solderReject: advisory hover feedback, not a hard stop.

Carried forward from the gate-cleared craft-station cycle. The instant of contact at the start of a legal SOLDER.BAY drop or CRAFT confirm, before the existing pieceFuse preset lands the weld 80ms later. A sharp, bright noise-based spark, distinct in timbre from pieceFuse's arpeggio so the two-part contact-then-settle read is audible as two separate events.

Carried forward from the gate-cleared craft-station cycle. A SOLDER.BAY drop or CRAFT/tap resolves illegally, or a drag/selection is cancelled onto empty space or via Escape. One preset covers both illegal-drop and pure cancel since both read as nothing happened, the piece is back home; distinct from the chrome-level deny preset, reading as a short-circuited joint rather than a generic beep.

A MANUAL.TXT tab click, a MANUAL.TXT PREV/NEXT click, or a DAD.LOG PREV/NEXT click, exactly once per navigation. A light, quick, papery noise burst, distinct from every existing noise-based preset (trapFire, strainCrack) by being far quieter and shorter - a page turning, not an impact. New because paging did not exist anywhere in KP/OS before this redesign.

A window is refocused by clicking it while a different window currently has focus (paired with the existing 220ms steps(4) kp-fw-focus-pulse border flash already shipped in wm.css). Fires once per focus change, never on a window's initial open (winOpen already covers that) and never when clicking an already-focused window. A soft, low, single square-wave thunk, quiet enough under frequent clicking across a stack of large windows; distinct from tick (sine, higher) and press (square with a downward slide).
